method.home: fresh mkdtemp per case; the machine profile and the live shell home are never read or written
method.authority: the dump composes through applyEntryPatches (vendor/include/src/index.ts:57), the same call boot() makes
method.stage: composition only; row admission is a later stage (app-boot/src/index.ts:407-408)
method.warningSink: stderr (app-boot/src/index.ts:427,435): a patch that matches no row is reported there
method.baseline: one unpatched composition per run; fixture observations are diffs by row id against it, because an insert shifts line numbers
method.calibration: every constructed case inserts a calibration row beside the row under test, so a missing effect cannot be read as acceptance when the overlay was never read
method.unknownToProbe: the probe records what composition did; it does not decide whether a key is honoured at mount

baseline.rowsMetric: deduplicated union of root ids and nested (indented) ids, empty-home default composition
